answer: Proposal: Each paid key sends a distinct 12-GiB stream to two independent receivers in a shared eight-second gale audit. Receiver targets wander each epoch; a ripple hash chain binds blocks to the key and nonce. Receivers sign full byte counts and timings. Proposed validators forfeit that key’s pay if either stream is late or reused. A farm can share a model and lease a backbone, but each clone requires two more simultaneous 12-GiB deliveries; rented egress cannot multicast different blocks. Independent receivers enforce this new gate, not MinePoA.
